In this scene, we’ve gone through an elaborate protocol to bring Gale back to life. He’s obviously very glad to live again, but he realises the player will have questions for him, questions he’s not actually ready to answer.

This dialogue takes place in two different states. The first is after the player has successfully fought back an army of goblins that attacked the druid grove. In the second state, the goblin leaders have been killed and the tieflings in the grove are leaving. She's aware of the hard work ahead required to make things go back to normal, but she's hopeful all the same.There's an extra node to acknowledge the missing idol, if it went missing before one of those two states were triggered.
context: Gale has just been returned to life and is still processing the aftermath of the climactic encounter with the Nether/elder brain. During that confrontation he sensed — and briefly saw — a remarkably potent Netherese crown linked to the brain, and believes studying it could be crucial. He’s excited and eager to pursue research at Sorcerous Sundries despite having come close to a self-destructive mishap earlier, so the player remains wary. This scene assumes the party has just survived the elder brain episode and that Gale’s recent near‑explosion and resurrection are known to the player.
